final: SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%' GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2 ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC LIMIT 10
